inputs.name: ClientProjectsService.constructor.options
inputs.description: options supplies the registry, outbox, repository arbiter, provider discovery service, image generator and run-event callback used by this client. Its optional projection cache is passed to each project session; the service does not create or default these dependencies.

inputs.name: ClientProjectsService.use.projectId
inputs.description: projectId is the registry key passed to registry.get() when opening a project. This service does not validate or transform it.

outputs.name: ClientProjectsService.roots
outputs.description: roots lists the root path of each project in this client's ready map, in map iteration order. Projects still opening are absent, and a missing session root is stored as an empty string.

outputs.name: ClientProjectsService.use
outputs.description: use opens the registered project for this client and resolves with its ClientProject after the session opens. Concurrent calls for the same id share the opening promise; calls after end() reject with Error, and an opening that finishes afterward is discarded.

outputs.name: ClientProjectsService.ended
outputs.description: ended reports whether end() has marked this client ended. The flag starts false and is never reset.

outputs.name: ClientProjectsService.end
outputs.description: end marks the client ended and cancels active runs for every ready project. Projects still opening are discarded when they finish, and later use() calls reject.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Error is rejected by use() when the client has ended, either before opening starts or after a project session opens. Its message is "This session has ended.".

outputs.name: ClientProjectsService.constructor
outputs.description: Construction stores the supplied options and initializes empty opening and ready maps with ended state false. The constructor has no explicit return value, so JavaScript creates the ClientProjectsService instance.
